resources.string: Confirm only if LelloStore opens and works correctly. This closes the recovery attempt and permits a new protected update. No app data is erased.
Keeps an independent device identity and monitors LelloStore self-updates.
Last-resort repair fully uninstalls LelloStore. Its local settings, login, caches, and any other local-only data will be deleted. Continue only when LelloStore cannot start.
